//: Template of the native-messaging host manifest the APP writes into each
browser's NativeMessagingHosts directory (HKCU registry on Windows) when
the user clicks 'Enable browser integration'. The app owns these files,
not the extension — that is what makes 'Repair integration' a single
button that rewrites every browser's copy at once.
Replace {path} with the absolute path to the Castellan binary and keep
the extension IDs in sync with the store IDs pinned at first submission.
name: app.castellan.host
description: Castellan vault access for the Fob extension
